header: scripts/harvest-fares.ts: collects and saves the fares of every express and mail train that stops at Durgapur (or, with --station ASN, of every train of the Asansol tab: the trains that stop at Asansol and not at Durgapur, fares FROM ASANSOL), while the plant's paid RailRadar month lasts (to 14 Dec 2026). The fares are saved in the database (table public.train_fare, with the time received) and the card on the intranet shows them with "Fares last received ...". Run it now, and again about once a week until the month ends; after FARES_LIVE_UNTIL (src/lib/live/fareService.ts) it refuses to run, because on the free plan every request would be taken from the 100 a month the timetable needs. npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-fares.ts all trains whose saved fares are older than 48 hours (or missing) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-fares.ts --max-age-hours 120 a lazier pass (skips trains saved in the last 5 days) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-fares.ts --only 12019,12313 just these trains npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-fares.ts --limit 20 at most 20 trains this time npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-fares.ts --station ASN the same for the Asansol tab's trains (table public.train_fare_asn; the timetable is two requests: Asansol's board and Durgapur's with the pass-throughs) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-fares.ts list what is saved (how many trains, the oldest and newest time received); add --station ASN for Asansol's The LOCAL (MEMU) trains get a HINT instead (src/lib/live/ordinaryFare.ts: the railway's published fare table applied to the distance from Durgapur to the end station): ONE request each, for the train's schedule. Cost: 8 requests per express train (one per class), 1 per local train, and one for the timetable. A full pass over about 250 trains is about 2,000 requests of the 30,000 a month, paced at 27 a minute (the key's limit is 30), so about 75 minutes. You can stop it at any time and run it again: the trains already saved are skipped. It stops at once if RailRadar says the limit is reached or the key is refused.
